name: EPIC 210968253

text.card: A red giant 1,720 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.83 solar masses and 12.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,564 K at its surface.
